ENGLISH — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. Where is the Library
   D. Where is the library

2. When practising Intensive Reading: Play 1.4.1 Play: Structure and Setting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive Reading: Play 1.4.1 Play: Structure and Setting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Intensive Reading: Play 1.4.1 Play: Structure and Setting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive Reading: Play 1.4.1 Play: Structure and Setting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Intensive Reading: Play 1.4.1 Play: Structure and Setting.

3. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. goes
   C. went
   D. going

4. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Literature: Short Forms, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Literature: Short Forms.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Literature: Short Forms.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Literature: Short Forms.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Literature: Short Forms.

5. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link

7. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Gender Neutral Language, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Gender Neutral Language.

   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Gender Neutral Language.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Gender Neutral Language.

9. When practising Writing 1.5.1 Legibility and Neatness, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.5.1 Legibility and Neatness.

10. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text.

11. When practising Play: Structure and Setting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Play: Structure and Setting.

12. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. Only a joining word
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only an action

13. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. blue
   C. happiness
   D. run

14. When practising Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Plot, which approach is best? (1 mark)

----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 9.2.1 Extensive Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
